svg.title: Queen of the Thrones of the Waters: Queen of Cups · Water of Water (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Water of Water; rules from 20° Gemini to 20° Cancer, as Book T counts. Its ring: number 10 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1795880559377-7bvn43ltqw2.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
